# lore

**Product Rule**  
 **Purpose:** Find derivatives when two functions are multiplied together.  
 **Steps:**

1. Identify f(x)f(x)f(x) and g(x)g(x)g(x).  
2. Take the derivative of each separately.  
3. Use: first × derivative of second \+ second × derivative of first.  
4. Simplify.
